fields.VPNServer_mode: dropped: the legacy page's mode switch cursor; no rc reader
fields._pptpd_clients_end: dropped: add-row / editor widget, not a setting; becomes part of pptpd_clients (start-end)
fields._pptpd_clients_start: dropped: add-row / editor widget, not a setting; becomes part of pptpd_clients (start-end)
fields.ajax_vpnserver_client_status.xml: covered: pptp_connected lines parsed, shown next to the accounts
fields.pptpd_broadcast_option: dropped: add-row / editor widget, not a setting; becomes part of pptpd_broadcast
fields.pptpd_chap (values): covered as the fixed value 2 (MS-CHAPv2 only, vpn.c:197-199); MS-CHAPv1 and auto are no longer offered
fields.pptpd_clientlist_password: dropped: add-row / editor widget, not a setting; becomes part of a pptpd_clientlist record
fields.pptpd_clientlist_username: dropped: add-row / editor widget, not a setting; becomes part of a pptpd_clientlist record
fields.pptpd_dnsenable_x: dropped: add-row / editor widget, not a setting; becomes part of pptpd_dns1 / pptpd_dns2 (auto = both empty, vpn.c:222-226); one manual server is enough (B-PPTP-2)
fields.pptpd_mppe_128: dropped: checkbox of the retired option set; pptpd_mppe is fixed to 1 (MPPE-128 required) on every save (owner decision, vpn.c:201-210)
fields.pptpd_mppe_40: dropped: MPPE-40 is no longer offered (owner decision; vpn.c:201-210 bit 4)
fields.pptpd_mppe_no: dropped: No encryption is no longer offered (owner decision; vpn.c:203 bit 8 drops require-mppe)
fields.pptpd_ms_network_option: dropped: add-row / editor widget, not a setting; becomes part of pptpd_ms_network
fields.pptpd_radius / pptpd_radserver / pptpd_r: not carried - no stock GUI and radius.so / radattr.so are not in fs.install/usr/lib/pppd (dead on this build)
fields.pptpd_sr_ipaddr: dropped: add-row / editor widget, not a setting; becomes part of a pptpd_sr_rulelist record
fields.pptpd_sr_netmask: dropped: add-row / editor widget, not a setting; becomes part of a pptpd_sr_rulelist record
fields.pptpd_winsenable_x: dropped: add-row / editor widget, not a setting; becomes part of pptpd_wins1 / pptpd_wins2 (auto = both empty)
fields.restart_pptpd / stop_pptpd (+restart_sam: covered: restart_pptpd while enabled, stop_pptpd when turned off, restart_samba when enable or range changed and Samba is on; off-and-staying-off edits only save
fields.show_pass: dropped: the stock show-passwords checkbox put passwords in title attributes (B-PPTP-6); Reaper has a reveal switch that only redraws the cells
